SFDC_EXT_STORE_LOCATOR.name: Store Locator
SFDC_EXT_STORE_LOCATOR.description: Enables a shopper to find a store based on a given location.

SFDC_EXT_BOPIS.name: Buy Online Pickup In Store
SFDC_EXT_BOPIS.description: Enables a shopper to order online and pick up their order at a physical store. Requires the Store Locator and Multiship extensions to be installed.

SFDC_EXT_MULTISHIP.name: Multiship
SFDC_EXT_MULTISHIP.description: Enables shoppers to ship items to multiple different addresses in a single order.

SFDC_EXT_CUSTOMER_PREFERENCES.name: (Demo) Customer Preferences
SFDC_EXT_CUSTOMER_PREFERENCES.description: Enables shoppers to manage interests and shopping preferences from their account page.

SFDC_EXT_SHIPPING_DELIVERY.name: Shipping & Delivery
SFDC_EXT_SHIPPING_DELIVERY.description: Renders a SCAPI-backed delivery estimator on the PDP.

SFDC_EXT_PJ_SHARED.name: Papa Johns · Compartido
SFDC_EXT_PJ_SHARED.description: Tokens, componentes y utilidades compartidas de la demo (INT).

SFDC_EXT_PJ_PRODUCT.name: Papa Johns · Producto
SFDC_EXT_PJ_PRODUCT.description: Hoja de pizza, ficha, «Hazlo combo» y mitades (PRO).

SFDC_EXT_PJ_OFFERS.name: Papa Johns · Ofertas
SFDC_EXT_PJ_OFFERS.description: Ofertas por ocasión y constructor de combos (OFE).

SFDC_EXT_PJ_STORE.name: Papa Johns · Tienda
SFDC_EXT_PJ_STORE.description: Modalidad retiro o delivery y elección de tienda (TIE).

SFDC_EXT_PJ_CART.name: Papa Johns · Carrito
SFDC_EXT_PJ_CART.description: Pedido, canje de puntos y «Tu pedido» de escritorio (CAR).

SFDC_EXT_PJ_TRACKING.name: Papa Johns · Seguimiento
SFDC_EXT_PJ_TRACKING.description: Seguimiento y franja de pedido en curso (SEG).
